A private window carries none of the locked extensions
An extension cannot be force-installed into an Incognito, private or guest window — so while private browsing is available, every filter above can be sidestepped with Ctrl+Shift+N.

Block a category

A category blocks a whole set at once — its apps and its sites — around the clock. Adding one is free; taking it off again needs the password.

Blocked apps

A blocked application does not start, and is closed if it is already running. Adding one is free; removing one needs the password.

Scheduled blocks

A block enforces what it governs only during its windows, or — with a daily limit — once that much time has been used. Locking one means it cannot be released early.
